name: Kriti
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Greek PGI covering the whole island of Crete. Liatiko is the most planted grape at 38 percent of vines, followed by Kotsifali, Romeiko, Razaki and Mandilaria.
